summary: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing that Nasdaq granted an extension to regain compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(2), which requires at least 400 Total Holders for continued Global Market listing. The company had received a deficiency notice on September 2, 2026 and submitted a compliance plan on October 16, 2026. Under the extension, Pantages must furnish transfer-agent documentation evidencing 400 holders on or before March 1, 2027, or face delisting subject to a Listing Qualifications Panel appeal. No pricing or deal economics were disclosed.
